title: Positions searched per second: AlphaZero against Stockfish and Elmo (log scale)
description: Bar chart on a logarithmic scale. Stockfish 8 searched about 70 million positions a second in chess and Elmo about 35 million in shogi; AlphaZero searched about 80 thousand in chess and 40 thousand in shogi. Data: Silver et al. 2017, arXiv:1712.01815, table S4.
heading: POSITIONS SEARCHED PER SECOND · LOG SCALE
